esp32-nut-ecoflow

Web installer · source & docs

Work in progress. The EcoFlow River 3 BLE handshake has not yet been confirmed on real hardware.

Plug an ESP32-S3 (≥4 MB flash) into this computer, then:

Needs Chrome, Edge, or Opera on desktop (Web Serial). The installer erases the flash and writes the firmware at offset 0x0. Later updates go over Wi-Fi from the device's own admin page — no cable.

After flashing

  1. The device starts an open Wi-Fi network esp-nut-ecoflow-XXXX. Join it; the setup page should open automatically (or browse to http://192.168.4.1/).
  2. Choose Join my Wi-Fi and pick your network — or Run its own AP to keep it standalone.
  3. Save. The page hands you the bridge's new address; open it.
  4. On the EcoFlow tab, scan and pick your River 3, then enter your EcoFlow account (email + password once, or paste your user id).
  5. Point your NUT clients at that address, port 3493.
